seo_title: Tim Hortons Case Study: Singapore Foodie Content | SOMIN
description: SOMIN read 12 months of Singapore cafe content for Tim Hortons: creators put 63% of their Foodie content into local discovery, while brands put 0%.
eyebrow: Creator case study · Cafe chain · Singapore
h1: Creators put 63% of Foodie content into discovery, Tim Hortons puts 0%
lede: SOMIN read 12 months of Foodie content from Tim Hortons, six Singapore competitors and four Foodie creators. Creators put 63% of theirs into authentic local discovery and cafe experience; the brands put 0%.
meta_line: A SOMIN creator briefing · Sep 2025 to Sep 2026 · Singapore · Foodies

challenge.title: Tim Hortons faces 6 Singapore rivals that already own value
challenge.body: Starbucks, Luckin Coffee, Tanamera Coffee, The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf, Koi and Paris Baguette Singapore already own value and affordable indulgence. Where could Tim Hortons stand out without out-shouting them?

approach.title: Brand, competitor and creator cohorts over 12 windows
points: Re-ran 12 monthly windows against the year before (n=692).
Compared cohorts by share, not raw counts: Tim Hortons (71), competitors (939), creators (190).
Checked SOMIN's ads library for paid activity.
Linked the pillars to 45 moment triggers.
Added a live 30-day topicality study of 85 panel posts.

findings_title: Tim Hortons on discovery, value and small joys

findings.title: Discovery is wide open
findings.body: Brands leave it at 0%. In the last 30 days, it was still 39% of creator panel posts.

findings.title: Value is crowded
findings.body: Affordable indulgence rose from 11% to 19% of category content, prior-year verified, but competitors own it; novelty drops lead at 20%.

findings.title: Small joys are Tim Hortons' own strand
findings.body: Everyday connection and small-joy indulgence is 27% of Tim Hortons' content against competitors' 14%: partial, a strand to deepen.

delivered.title: Three pillars, nine propositions and a 38-post Q4 calendar
points: Pillars: The Discovery Destination (45%), Small Joys, Shared (35%) and Fuel for the Active City (20%)
Nine SOMIN propositions across product features, USP and promotion
From 1 Oct, three posts a week with 12 lead posts
108 creative concepts, 36 per pillar across the funnel

quote.text: Competitor absence is not permission. Each pillar rests on a real Tim Hortons asset.

outcome.title: Tim Hortons should claim The Discovery Destination first
outcome.body: Make each Tims store, drink and collab worth finding. No brand ran visible paid content, so it can be claimed without outbidding anyone; the other two pillars support it.

faq.q: Who are the Foodies in this briefing?
faq.a: Foodies means content made for Foodies, not a measured audience. The primary persona is The Community Connector.

faq.q: Why is value not the recommended pillar?
faq.a: Competitors own value, the category's centre of gravity, so it is blocked. Only discovery and aesthetic dining content have creators high and brands low.

faq.q: How reliable are the trend calls?
faq.a: Brand and competitor trends were checked against the prior year. Creator trends start around Dec 2025 and are unverified, and Sep to Dec 2025 is low confidence.
